subject: Physics
q: A plano-convex lens in air has a curved surface of radius 30 cm and is made of material with refractive index 1.5. Find its focal length in centimetres.
hint: Apply the lens-maker formula with one surface plane.
solution: For a thin plano-convex lens in air, 1/f = (n - 1)(1/R - 1/∞) = (1.5 - 1)/30 = 1/60 cm⁻¹. Therefore f = 60 cm.
